# acli-py sprint

Plan, start and close sprints.


## `acli-py sprint list`

List a board's sprints.

```text
acli-py sprint list [BOARD] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BOARD` |  | Board id (default: config). |
| `-s`, `--state` `TEXT` |  | future, active or closed (repeatable). |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `acli-py sprint view`

Show a sprint.

```text
acli-py sprint view SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py sprint create`

Create a future sprint on a board.

```text
acli-py sprint create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` `TEXT` | required | Sprint name. |
| `-b`, `--board` `INTEGER` |  | Board id (default: `acli-py config set board`). |
| `--start` `TEXT` |  | Start: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--end` `TEXT` |  | End: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `-g`, `--goal` `TEXT` |  | Sprint goal. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py sprint update`

Rename a sprint or change its dates or goal.

```text
acli-py sprint update SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `--name` `TEXT` |  | Sprint name. |
| `--start` `TEXT` |  | Start: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--end` `TEXT` |  | End: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `-g`, `--goal` `TEXT` |  | Sprint goal. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint start`

Start a future sprint (now, for --weeks, unless dates are given).

```text
acli-py sprint start SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `--start` `TEXT` |  | Start: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--end` `TEXT` |  | End: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO time. |
| `--weeks` `INTEGER` | `2` | Length when no --end is given. |
| `-g`, `--goal` `TEXT` |  | Sprint goal. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint close`

Complete an active sprint. Unfinished issues go back to the backlog.

```text
acli-py sprint close SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint delete`

Delete sprints; their issues move to the backlog.

```text
acli-py sprint delete SPRINTS [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINTS` | required | Sprint ids. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors` |  | Keep going when one item fails; exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint issues`

List the issues in a sprint.

```text
acli-py sprint issues SPRINT [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL finds. |
| `--fields` `TEXT` |  | Columns, comma-separated field ids. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `acli-py sprint add`

Move issues into a sprint.

```text
acli-py sprint add SPRINT [KEYS] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRINT` | required | Sprint id (see `acli-py sprint list`). |
| `KEYS` |  | Issue keys (DEMO-1 DEMO-2, or DEMO-1,DEMO-2). |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL finds. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py sprint remove`

Move issues out of their sprint, back to the backlog.

```text
acli-py sprint remove [KEYS] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEYS` |  | Issue keys (DEMO-1 DEMO-2, or DEMO-1,DEMO-2). |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL finds. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
